label: High distress, highly educated women with heavy daily use
summary: Respondents in this profile report comparatively higher loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms. The group is anchored by women with graduate-level education or above who report more than 5 hours of daily use.

behavior_markers: Represents a training-split profile size of 170 respondents
tone: Vulnerable, psychologically burdened, and intensive in daily use
